findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agent_playbook · Private data: get_agent_playbook, run_agent, get_ai_services · Public sink: get_agent_playbook, run_agent · Destructive: get_agent_playbook, run_agent, get_ai_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agent_playbook · Private data: get_agent_playbook, run_agent, get_ai_services · Public sink: get_agent_playbook, run_agent · Destructive: get_agent_playbook, run_agent, get_ai_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
